d: We are looking for a proactive and versatile Human Resources Specialist to manage and support the full spectrum of Human Resources functions within a fast-growing startup environment.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, HR operations, payroll, employee relations, government platforms, performance management, compensation and benefits, and employee engagement.

This role requires a hands-on professional who can independently manage day-to-day HR activities, ensure compliance with Saudi Labor Law, and contribute to building and improving HR policies, procedures, and processes as the company grows.
Manage the full employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding.
Prepare and manage employment contracts, job offers, and employee documentation.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and personnel files.
Manage attendance, leaves, employee transfers, promotions, and other employment changes.
Prepare employment letters, certificates, and HR-related documentation.
Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and operational guidelines.
Ensure smooth and efficient day-to-day HR operations.
Manage end-to-end recruitment activities in coordination with department managers.
Develop and publish job advertisements across relevant recruitment channels.
Screen CVs, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate interview processes.
Manage candidate communication, job offers, and hiring procedures.
Maintain and develop a candidate database and recruitment pipeline.
Monitor recruitment progress and hiring timelines.
Manage onboarding and probation processes for new employees.
Prepare, review, and process monthly payroll, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
Manage salary adjustments, allowances, deductions, overtime, and other employee payments.
Coordinate with the Finance Department regarding payroll processing and employee payments.
Manage employee medical insurance and benefits administration.
Calculate and review end-of-service benefits, leave settlements, and final payments.
Maintain payroll records and ensure confidentiality of compensation information.
Manage employee-related government transactions and regulatory requirements.
Handle and maintain relevant government platforms, including:
Manage work permits, Iqama renewals, employment transfers, and other related transactions.
Ensure compliance with Saudi Labor Law and its implementing regulations.
Monitor Saudization requirements, Nitaqat status, and relevant regulatory updates.
Ensure timely completion of government-related requirements and documentation.
Coordinate and support the implementation of periodic and annual performance review cycles.
Assist departments in setting objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Monitor performance evaluation processes and follow up with department managers.
Identify training and development needs in coordination with business units.
Support employee development initiatives and training programs.
Act as a point of contact for employee inquiries, concerns, and HR-related matters.
Support employee engagement and internal communication initiatives.
Organize employee activities, events, and engagement programs.
Conduct employee satisfaction surveys and support the analysis of results.
Promote a positive workplace culture and employee experience.
Support employee retention initiatives and monitor employee turnover.
Handle employee complaints and workplace matters professionally.
Manage employee resignations, terminations, and contract closures.
Conduct exit interviews and analyze employee turnover reasons.
Prepare and review final settlements and end-of-service benefits.
Coordinate clearance procedures, company asset returns, and employee account closures.
Ensure all offboarding procedures comply with Saudi Labor Law and company policies.
q: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
2–4 years of relevant experience in Human Resources.
Good knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and HR regulatory requirements.
Hands-on experience with Qiwa, GOSI, Mudad, and Muqeem platforms.
Practical experience in payroll processing and compensation administration.
Knowledge of recruitment, employee relations, and HR operations.
Experience using HRMS platforms and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Strong reporting, analytical, and organizational skills.
Good command of both Arabic and English.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Strong organizational and time management abilities.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic startup environment.
Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
High level of confidentiality and professionalism.
